name: Volunteering Matters Action Earth (Scotland)
summary: Micro-grants for volunteer-led projects creating or improving wildlife habitat in urban green spaces in Scotland, such as meadows, ponds and woodlands. Projects need at least 15 volunteers.

eligibility.rule: Project involves practical outdoor activity by volunteers in Scotland
At least 15 volunteers each contribute at least 5 hours
Project site is publicly accessible, subject to community-site exceptions
Project is completed and feedback submitted by 28 February 2027
Project is outside remote rural settings, unless an exception applies
Food growing is not the project's primary focus
Project does not take place on school grounds

status.quote: The programme is now open for 2026 applications, offering grants to help urban communities improve their local environment.

applicant_types.quote: We prioritise applications from volunteer groups that do any of the following:

geography.quote: The project must involve practical outdoor activity by volunteers in Scotland.

access.quote: The programme is now open for 2026 applications, offering grants to help urban communities improve their local environment.

amount.quote: Action Earth provides grants of up to £250 for volunteer-led projects in towns, cities and built-up areas.

administered_by.quote: Delivered by Volunteering Matters and supported by the National Lottery Community Fund, Action Earth provides grants of up to £250

effort.quote: Action Earth is now open for 2026 applications

eligibility.quote: The project must involve practical outdoor activity by volunteers in Scotland.
A minimum of 15 volunteers (and preferably more) must be involved in the project, each giving at least 5 hours of volunteering time
The project site must be open and accessible to the general public. Exceptions may be made where a community site has limited access such as a Care Home or Hospital.
All projects must be completed and feedback submitted by 28 February 2027.
Projects in remote rural settings (unless involving disabled people/defined health groups or working in areas of multiple deprivation)
Food growing cannot be the primary focus.
We cannot fund any projects on school grounds.

after_award.quote: Feedback and receipts should be submitted within four weeks of completion of your project.
